response.original_title: Ocean of Mercy: Three Lives - One Vision
response.overview: "Ocean of Mercy" (subtitled Three Lives - One Vision - No Limits) is a 2013 religious documentary film released by Ignatius Press that explores the message of Divine Mercy originating from Poland.  Release Date: July 2013 Run Time: 1 hour and 15 minutes Core Subject: “At the dawn of the 20th century, three voices rose up from Poland to proclaim an urgent message, a message powerful enough the alter the course of an age plunging into spiritual darkness.”
response.tagline: Three Lives, One Vision, No Limits
